import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the existing docs table
table = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Create an embedding column using sentence-transformers UDF
# This embeds the 'content' column with model 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
table['content_embedding'] = pxt.functions.sentence_transformers(
    table['content'],
    model='all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
)

# Create a vector index on the embedding column for nearest-neighbor search
table.create_index('content_embedding', index_type='vector')

# Define the query text
query_text = "climate change policy"

# Embed the query using the same model
query_embedding = pxt.functions.sentence_transformers(
    query_text,
    model='all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
)

# Perform semantic search: retrieve 5 nearest neighbors
results = table.search(
    'content_embedding',
    query_embedding,
    limit=5
)

# Convert to DataFrame and display results sorted by distance (closest to farthest)
results_df = results.to_pandas().sort_values('_distance')
print(results_df[['content', '_distance']])
